- Line-item granularity: do you require a per-feature/service/sku line per invoice, or do you accept consolidated monthly lines? Any required fields for each line (service period, SKU, GL code, taxability)?
- Typical lead time to issue the first PO after vendor form + SOW are submitted (we're trying to coordinate a go-live on 7/20).
- Are blanket/standing POs supported (month-to-month charge consolidation)?
- Any vendor portal or e-invoicing integration we should use (Peppol, Ariba, Coupa)?

We can attach our standard SOW and a completed W-9 today. If you can send any vendor setup template or a line-item CSV sample that would speed things up.

Appreciate a quick confirmation so we can keep the 7/20 timeline.

Best,

Hi Anya — great to hear from you. Thanks for the clear list. I pulled together our standard requirements and a sample line-item template (attached) — below is a concise checklist and expected timeline.

Required vendor docs (US):
- W-9 (required)
- Completed Redwood vendor setup form (attached)
- Signed SOW or order form referencing pricing and term (attached SOW is fine)
- Remittance contact + billing email
- Bank details only if we will set up ACH for pre-authorized payments (we usually require an additional vendor bank verification for ACH)
- Certificate of Insurance (if work involves on-site or professional services above threshold)

PO issuance and timeline:
- Typical turnaround: 5–7 business days after we receive a complete vendor profile + signed SOW.
- Expedited: 24–72 hours if we have manager approval and marked urgent (please note expedited POs may require confirmatory email approvals).
- For your 7/20 go-live, we need the completed vendor form + signed SOW by 7/13 to be in the safe 5–7 day window.

Line-item structure guidance (what we prefer in the CSV template):
- sku | description | quantity | unit_price | tax_code | gl_code | service_period_start | service_period_end | taxable (Y/N) | cost_center | notes
- For recurring SaaS seats: include service_period_start and end for each line.
- For usage billing: provide rate and measured quantity fields.
- If you prefer consolidated monthly lines, please specify which billable items are being aggregated and include a reconciliation appendix so finance can match to usage reports.

Other notes:
- Redwood generally uses the PO prefix RDW-<VENDORCODE> for internal routing. We will generate the Redwood PO number (we prefer vendors to reference our PO on invoices).
- We can accept consolidated monthly lines for predictable SaaS subscriptions; professional services typically need itemization per milestone.
- We support emailed invoices (billing@redwood.com) and a basic SFTP/e-invoicing option (contact AP for setup).

Next steps:
1) Please complete the attached redwood_vendor_setup_form.pdf and return with W-9 and signed SOW.
2) Fill the attached po_lineitem_template.csv for your first invoice.
3) Confirm if you require ACH setup — if yes, indicate bank verification timing.

I'm copying Monica (Finance onboarding) and Dev (Vendor ops) so they can expedite once we have your documents. Happy to hop on a 20-min call if helpful.

Thanks,
David Kim
Vendor Enablement | Redwood Inference
---
(Attachments: redwood_vendor_setup_form.pdf, po_lineitem_template.csv)
